# Review PR

Review the supplied change for actionable bugs, regressions, contract violations, and missing coverage.

Use [the review context pack](../../.ai/context/review.md) for task-specific guidance; repository policy remains in `AGENTS.md`. Do not reread guidance already in context.

## Completion

Lead with findings by severity and file/line evidence, then open questions. If there are no findings, state that and identify residual risks or missing validation.
